question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund takes an UNHEDGED position in Credit Default Swaps (CDS) as part of a Cat III strategy. Per SEBI Circular dated January 12, 2023 on AIF participation in CDS, what is the limit on gross UNHEDGED CDS positions?

answer.text: Up to 10% of investable funds without additional disclosure
Up to 25% of investable funds; unit-holder intimation required if exceeded at the time of taking the position
Unhedged CDS is prohibited for all Cat III AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI January 12, 2023 circular, AIF gross unhedged CDS positions should be up to 25% of investable funds of the scheme. If at the time of taking the unhedged position gross unhedged CDS exceeds 25%, the position may be taken only after INTIMATING all unit-holders. Hedged CDS counts toward leverage. The Trap: Option A (10%) confuses with concentration limit. Option C (50%) inflates. Option D is wrong — Cat III can buy/sell CDS subject to leverage and concentration limits. Cross-Exam Context: VIII (Derivatives), XIX-C, XIX-D test CDS rules. XIX-E specifically tests Cat III's CDS participation. Manager's Pro-Tip: For CDS-sell, earmark unencumbered G-Secs/T-bills equal to exposure — these are excluded from leverage computation but count toward margin. Report to custodian next working day.
